text:
maria-sales: Hey team, Atherium just asked for a quick throughput/latency verification before we send the formal quote. Can we run a thin-client style smoke benchmark (short duration) to validate 200 qps sustained with 99th < 250ms for the text-gen path? Need runbook and back-of-envelope cost within EOD.
jasper-eng: Yep can do. Quick q's: which model variant (base vs quantized), avg tokens in/out, and region?
tess-ml: For thin-client they're using a short prompt (<=60 tokens) and expecting ~30 tokens generated on average. Suggest using the quantized v2-small for cost realism, but also include one run with v2-medium for latency comparison.
maria-sales: Region is us-east-1. They care about price but will pay for reliability. Include a fallback run to smaller model for peak shedding.
leo-ops: I'll draft a runbook. Proposed test plan: 1) warmup 2m at 20 qps, 2) ramp 1m to 200 qps, 3) sustain 5m at 200 qps, 4) spike 30s @ 400 qps, 5) cool down. We'll capture p50/p95/p99 and tail counts.
leo-ops: k6 command I'm planning to use:
```bash
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 7m --out json=run.json k6_thinclient_test.js
```
jasper-eng: For server config: use 2 dedicated GPU workers (A10) with batching window 25ms and kv-cache enabled. Set max batch tokens to 512. That should hit <250ms p99 for v2-small on sustained 200 qps.
tess-ml: Add an eval run where we disable kv-cache to see worst-case. Also run a 1-min microburst at 800 qps to validate overload behavior.
eva-se: Heads up: Atherium's security questionnaire flagged KMS key residency + audit logs. For the test we'll note that logs include request IDs but not customer payload. I'll prepare a one-paragraph security note for the sales deck.
maria-sales: Nice. Can someone give quick cost estimate for a 1-hour dedicated run and a 1-hour hosted-equivalent burn? Need numbers for the quote.
leo-ops: Rough estimate: Dedicated (2xA10 reserved) ~ $7.2/hr infra; with runtime amortization + networking ~ $12/hr. Hosted per-token burn (quantized v2-small) for 200 qps * 30 tokens * 3600s ~ 648M tokens -> ~ $1,300 at current hosted list. For the short POC runs (10-15m) it's negligible.
jasper-eng: I can produce the run artifacts and sample traces. I'll also capture per-token latency breakdown so we can show batching and kernel times.
eva-se: For the security note: "Test runs use masked inputs; customer data not stored. Audit logs include RequestID, model version, timestamp, worker id. KMS-managed keys can be demonstrated on a private deployment but not enabled for hosted smoke runs." Use that phrasing if you want.
maria-sales: Perfect. Last asks: 1) Can we commit to results by EOD? 2) Any enterprise blockers like HSM or SSO that would stop the POC?
jasper-eng: typo — jasper-eng: I'll run tonight and share results by 18:00. No HSM needed for smoke. SSO/SSO scoping only matters for longer private evals.
tess-ml: No model licensing blockers for these open variants. If Atherium needs signed agreements for embeddings/exports we'll escalate.
leo-ops: I'll post the runbook and k6 script into the prospect folder, and attach a small README with commands and what to look for.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New loadtest job created: job_id=lt-1767552467-1 status=queued
maria-sales: Awesome, thanks all. I'll update Atherium with the timeline and ask them to share any security question forms so eva can prefill. :thumbsup:
